access_assignment_one_per_plan_person_st.name: access_assignment_one_per_plan_person_start
access_assignment_one_per_plan_person_st.where: person_id is not null and status <> 'cancelled'

access_assignment_end_is_a_month.name: access_assignment_end_is_a_month
access_assignment_end_is_a_month.value: end_month is null or date_trunc('month', end_month) = end_month

access_assignment_period_ordered.name: access_assignment_period_ordered
access_assignment_period_ordered.value: end_month is null or end_month > start_month

access_plan_price_sane.name: access_plan_price_sane
access_plan_price_sane.value: price_minor is null or (price_minor >= 0 and char_length(currency) = 3)

membership_purchase_one_unresolved_perso.name: membership_purchase_one_unresolved_person
membership_purchase_one_unresolved_perso.where: person_id is not null and status in ('pending','claimed','rejected','resolution')

cl_reminder_due.name: cl_reminder_due
cl_reminder_due.where: reminder_sent_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
